title: Hot Cocoa Mix

drivers.name: Store closure (Monday)
drivers.evidence: Store closed Monday for renovation; 20% reduction in selling days. No prior closures in history; weak evidence, so shrink effect.

drivers.name: Price increase (3.4%)
drivers.evidence: Price up 3.4% vs regular; no promotion. Past price changes show minimal demand impact. Noise-adjusted effect is near 1.0.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 30.4. The store closes Monday, reducing the selling window by 20%, which likely reduces sales. The price increase to $5.20 (3.4% above regular) is modest and not tied to a promotion, so it likely has a small negative effect. Recent weeks show a slight uptick (32 units at $5.20), but no promotion occurred. Past promotions had small noise-adjusted effects (x1.0), and the post-promo dip was x0.83, but this is not a promo week. No seasonal or holiday drivers are present. The classical model suggests no lift, which aligns with weak evidence. The closure is the only clear negative driver. Adjust for 20% sales loss due to closure, but shrink the effect due to uncertainty (only one past closure event).

brief:
PRODUCT: Hot Cocoa Mix | category Grocery | Store #12 (Austin, TX)
TARGET WEEK: 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-15 (5 weeks after the last week with sales data)

KNOWN PLAN FOR THE TARGET WEEK:
  events: none
  shelf price: 5.20 (+3.4% vs regular price 5.03)
  planner notes: Store closed Monday for renovation

STATISTICAL BASELINE (exponential smoothing of recent sales; it ignores events, promotions and prices):
  median 30.4 | 5%-95%: 2.9 - 48.1 | 10%-90%: 7.6 - 47.6

In the evidence below, 'vs baseline' = actual units / what this same baseline predicted for that week.
It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-77% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
